# Series 9

## Exercise 9.1

### A

```{r}
library(astsa)
data(prodn)

plot(prodn)
```

### B

```{r}
plot(diff(log(prodn)))
```

### C

```{r}
prodn.trans <- diff(log(prodn))

acf(prodn.trans)
```

```{r}
pacf(prodn.trans)
```

```{r}
library(forecast)

fit<-arima(
    x=prodn.trans,
    order=c(1,1,1),
    seasonal=c(1,1,1)
    )

tsdisplay(fit$residual)
```

```{r}
fitAuto<-auto.arima(prodn.trans, ic="aic")
fitAuto

tsdisplay(fitAuto$residual)
```
